manifest.name: The Ashlands
manifest.tagline: Where the embers never quite die.
manifest.description: A burnt frontier on the edge of the old empire. The Ember Wardens hold the passes against the Ashen Horde, goblin warbands that crawl out of the cinder wastes every dry season.

regions.name: The Ashen Marches
regions.description: Rolling black hills where every road is lined with the ribs of old watchtowers.

regions.name: Cinder Pass
regions.description: The only way through the Marches. Hold it and the Horde stays out.

locations.name: Warden Keep
locations.description: A squat basalt keep, its hearth never allowed to go cold.

locations.name: The Ruined Courtyard
locations.description: What is left of a watch post: broken arches and a sooty cobbled square, ideal for an ambush.

markers.locked_text: Warden barricades close the gate road until the Courtyard is held.

locations.name: The Cinder Gate
locations.description: A collapsed toll arch at the top of the gorge, where the pass opens onto the wastes.

markers.label: Signal beacon
markers.note: You light the old Warden beacon. Smoke climbs over the pass.

locations.name: The Ashmaw Camp
locations.description: A ring of hide tents in the wastes, smoke rising from a dozen fires.

factions.name: Ember Wardens
factions.description: A border order of soldiers and scouts sworn to hold the Cinder Pass. Poorly funded, fiercely loyal.

factions.name: The Ashen Horde
factions.description: Loose goblin warbands united by hunger and a few loud chieftains.

characters.name: Mara Voss
characters.title: Captain of the Ember Wardens
characters.background: Raised in the keep's kitchens, Mara earned her captaincy by holding the Courtyard alone for two nights. She trusts drills over speeches.

characters.name: Tev Quill
characters.title: Scout of the Pass
characters.background: A quiet orphan of the Marches who reads smoke like other people read books.

characters.name: Hest the Quartermaster
characters.title: Keeper of the Stores
characters.background: Counts every arrow twice and every soldier three times.

characters.name: Skarn Ironjaw
characters.title: Brawler of the Horde
characters.background: Cracked his jaw on a Warden shield and never stopped grinning about it.

characters.name: Vex the Cutpurse
characters.title: Skirmisher
characters.background: Goes for whoever bleeds first.

characters.name: Nok Flamebow
characters.title: Horde Archer
characters.background: Fires pitch-tipped arrows from the ridgeline and runs when anyone gets close.

characters.name: Gruk Smokecaller
characters.title: Warband Shaman
characters.background: Claims the ash talks to him. It mostly says 'attack'.

characters.name: Bolg Redhand
characters.title: Berserker
characters.background: Has never retreated, mostly because he forgets there is a direction for it.

characters.name: Horde Brawler
characters.title: Warband Muscle
characters.background: One of many who fight for whoever feeds them.

characters.name: Horde Skirmisher
characters.title: Warband Runner
characters.background: Fast, light and never alone.

characters.name: Horde Archer
characters.title: Warband Bow
characters.background: Shoots from the ridges and runs.

characters.name: Horde Smokecaller
characters.title: Warband Shaman
characters.background: Mutters at the ash and patches the wounded.

characters.name: Horde Berserker
characters.title: Warband Berserker
characters.background: Screams first, thinks never.

characters.name: Horde Warchief
characters.title: Patrol Leader
characters.background: Leads the patrols that circle the ruins.

characters.name: Grakka Ashmaw
characters.title: Chieftain of the Horde
characters.background: Wears a crown of rusted nails, one for every Warden post he burned.

characters.name: Bryn Hale
characters.title: Warden Recruit
characters.background: A Warden's son from the burned post at Emberfall; carries his father's shield and his temper.

characters.name: Sella Marsh
characters.title: Archer of the North Wall
characters.background: Hunts ash-hares in the wastes and counts every arrow twice.

characters.name: Kit Vane
characters.title: Oathbound Cutpurse
characters.background: Stole from the Wardens once, got caught, and stayed.

characters.name: Oren Dusk
characters.title: Hedge-Mage of the Forge
characters.background: Reads embers the way Tev reads smoke; nobody asks where he learned fire.

characters.name: Alda Wren
characters.title: Hearth-Keeper
characters.background: Tends the keep's one fire and every Warden who comes back from the pass.

characters.name: Dagny Coal
characters.title: Pit Fighter of Slag Gate
characters.background: Fought for coin in the slag pits until the Horde burned them; fists are what she kept.

characters.name: Brask Toller
characters.title: Muster Sergeant of the Wardens
characters.background: Keeps the duty roll in his head and the names of the dead on his belt.

characters.name: Wenn Tallow
characters.title: Orsa's Carter
characters.background: Orsa's nephew; drives the steel wagon and swears he can shoot.

items.name: Ember-Scale Brigandine
items.description: Leather studded with cooled slag scales.
items.history: Forged from the keep's first fire; passed to every captain of the Wardens.

items.name: Hest's Buckler
items.description: A small buckler worn smooth by years of carrying.

items.name: Brask's Buckler
items.description: A small buckler worn smooth by years of carrying.

disciplines.name: Ember Blade
disciplines.description: The Wardens' close-order sword drill: short strokes, never overextend.

disciplines.name: Cinder Archery
disciplines.description: Shooting through smoke and heat shimmer; scouts learn to aim at the shape, not the glare.

quests.name: Hold the Courtyard
quests.description: The Long Dry has come early, and the Horde with it. Mara needs the Courtyard held while the keep's gates are shored up.

steps.text: Drive the warband out of the Ruined Courtyard

quests.reward: The Wardens' thanks, and a share of the keep's winter stores.

set.description: Mara is gone. Tev holds the line in her place: clear the Courtyard.

quests.name: Watch at the Cinder Gate
quests.description: Mara suspects the warband left scouts in the pass. Find them before they find the keep. Take someone from Toller's roll first; the pass is no place to walk alone.

steps.text: Break the ambush at the Cinder Gate

quests.reward: The Wardens' thanks, and a pick from the keep.

set.description: Mara is gone. Tev means to finish what she started and clear the pass himself.
set.reward: Tev's thanks and what the keep can spare.

quests.name: The Warden's Oath
quests.description: Once the pass is safe, Tev will speak for the party before the Wardens.

steps.text: Wait for word that the Cinder Gate is clear
Return to Warden Keep and swear the oath

quests.reward: A Warden's gift, and the oath.

set.description: With Mara gone, Tev asks the party to swear the oath over her empty seat.

1.text: Swear the oath in the Ruined Courtyard where Mara fell

quests.name: Sweep the Ruins
quests.description: Hest wants the ruins swept of raiders before the next supply run.

steps.text: Break a raiding party in the ruins

quests.reward: Hest's gratitude and a pick from the stores.

quests.name: Steel for the Gate
quests.description: The Cinder Gate will not hold another Long Dry on timber. Mara sends you up the south road to Slag Gate for Orsa Tallow's steel.

steps.text: Load Orsa's steel at Slag Gate
Bring the steel to Warden Keep

quests.reward: Hest's thanks and a pick from the stores.

quests.name: Keep One Fire Lit
quests.description: Grakka Ashmaw has gathered the warbands past the Cinder Gate. Break him and the Horde scatters.
quests.reward: The Wardens' gratitude and the chieftain's torc.

1.text: Break Grakka; the barred gate cut off his flankers

lore.name: The Long Dry
lore.text: Every dry season the wells of the cinder wastes run out and the Horde marches. The Wardens call it the Long Dry, and keep a tally of how many they have survived.

lore.name: Keep One Fire Lit
lore.text: The first Warden swore never to let the keep's hearth go cold. The Wardens say the Horde fears the glow more than the steel.

lore.name: The Ashmaw Banner
lore.text: A hide banner nailed to the arch, one skull per warband. Somebody is uniting the Horde.

encounters.name: Holding the Courtyard
encounters.description: Bryn against two Horde raiders in the Ruined Courtyard.
encounters.intro: The Horde has come early this year. Two raiders drop from the Courtyard wall, blades out.
encounters.objective_text: Hold the Courtyard: keep the ring for 3 rounds, or drive them off.

encounters.name: Ambush at the Cinder Gate
encounters.description: A brawler and a skirmisher bait the party; at Round 1 Block 4 an archer and a smokecaller fall on them.
encounters.intro: Too quiet. Bryn raises a hand: smoke, upwind, much too close.

encounters.name: Horde Scouts
encounters.description: Two scouts testing the Wardens' patrols; drop one and the other yields.
encounters.morale_text: The last scout drops its blade in the ash.

encounters.name: Horde Raiders
encounters.description: A small raiding party looking for easy prey; their smokecaller holds them together.
encounters.intro: Raiders spill out of the ruins.
encounters.morale_text: With the smokecaller down, the raiders throw down their arms.

encounters.name: Horde Patrol
encounters.description: A warchief and his berserker on their rounds.

encounters.name: Stand at the Ashmaw Camp
encounters.description: Grakka and his guard make a stand; the flankers pour out of the gorge at Round 2; at half strength Grakka throws off his crown.
encounters.intro: Grakka rises from the fire, nail-crown glinting.

effects.label: The flankers pour out of the gorge!

effects.text: Grakka tears the nail-crown from his head and hurls it into the fire. The smokecallers begin to chant.

encounters.objective_text: Break Grakka Ashmaw; the Horde scatters when he falls.

encounters.name: Stand at the Ashmaw Camp (barred gate)
encounters.description: Grakka and his guard stand alone; the barred gate cut off the flankers; at half strength Grakka throws off his crown.
encounters.intro: Grakka looks past you to the gorge. Nobody comes.

effects.text: Grakka tears the nail-crown from his head and hurls it into the fire. The smokecallers begin to chant.
Grakka bellows at the gorge. Nothing answers.

encounters.objective_text: Break Grakka Ashmaw; the Horde scatters when he falls.

encounters.name: A Horde Straggler
encounters.description: A lone Horde brawler cut off from his warband.
encounters.intro: A straggler lurches out of the rubble.

encounters.name: Raid on the Steel Wagon
encounters.description: Raiders hit Orsa's wagon on the south road; Wenn must live to drive it home.
encounters.intro: The wagon lurches. Goblins come out of the ditch on both sides.

loot.name: Wardens' Drill
loot.description: Mara's drill against fear, taught to those who held the line.

loot.name: Rallying Cry
loot.description: The Wardens' call that steadies a wavering line.

loot.name: Keep Ring
loot.description: A heavy ring from the keep's strongbox.

loot.name: Keep Stores
loot.description: A satchel of the keep's healing draughts.

loot.name: Warchief's Axe
loot.description: A notched Horde axe, still warm from the warchief's grip.

nodes.text: Mara looks up from a map pinned flat with knives. "Make it quick."

choices.text: These ash drifts are fresh. The Horde is close.
The steel is here. Where does it go?
It's over. The Horde is scattered.
It's over. The Horde is scattered.

nodes.text: "Warden Keep. One fire, four walls and too few of us to hold either."
"Sharp eyes. Take this; you will need it before I do."
"It is. For now. Drink to it later."
Mara weighs a bar of slag-steel. "Enough for one thing done well. The gate, or your hands?"
"Then the gorge is shut behind you. Whatever waits in the wastes waits alone."
"Then go out sharp. Hest has the rest on his counter."
"One fire lit, and a door that holds. The Long Dry is over. This year."
"The wastes will remember that steel. Rest; you have earned the hearth."
Tev is whittling arrow shafts. "Smoke's wrong today."
"Too much of it, too close, and upwind. Someone wants us looking the wrong way."
"Then I owe you a drink and an arrow. Have the arrow money."
"Slag Gate, up the south road. Orsa sells to us at cost. Take the signpost to the world map."
Hest counts arrows without looking up. "Buying or bothering?"

choices.text: Trade a fire bomb back for coin?
Any spare stores for friends of the Wardens?

nodes.text: "Fewer bombs in the hall is fine by me."
"Everything. Bring the potions back unopened and we will get along."
"For you? Two, and don't tell the others."
A goblin in a crown of rusted nails grins over the fire. "Come to beg for your little flame?"

choices.text: Then we fight. Your flankers are not coming.

nodes.text: "The Long Dry is mine. Your fire goes out tonight."
Toller runs a thumb down the duty roll. "The keep can spare a blade or two, Warden. No more."

choices.text: The oath is sworn. Who else?

nodes.text: Toller nods at the yard. "Pick one. The rest stay on the wall."

choices.text: Sella Marsh, the archer on the north wall.
Kit Vane, the cutpurse who took the oath.
Oren Dusk, the hedge-mage by the forge.
Dagny Coal, the pit fighter from Slag Gate.

nodes.text: Toller strikes a line through a name. "Bring them back."

manifest.name: The Iron Reaches
manifest.tagline: Mines, forges and a road south.
manifest.description: A mining highland that does not inherit the Ashlands but is linked to them: its road leads down into Warden Keep.

regions.name: The Ore Highlands
regions.description: Cold terraces cut into the mountain, lit by furnace glow.

exits.label: the south road to Warden Keep

factions.name: The Forge Guild
factions.description: Smiths and miners who trade slag-steel to anyone who pays.

characters.name: Orsa Tallow
characters.title: Guildmistress
characters.background: Sells the Wardens steel at cost and never says why.

items.name: Orsa's Buckler
items.description: A small buckler worn smooth by years of carrying.

quests.name: Iron for the Embers
quests.description: Escort a slag-steel shipment down the south road to Warden Keep.

steps.text: Deliver the shipment to Warden Keep

quests.reward: A discount at the Guild forge.

nodes.text: Orsa wipes soot from her hands. "Wardens. Thought you'd come."

choices.text: Why sell to the Wardens at cost?
Mara sent us for the steel.

nodes.text: "A Warden captain pulled me out of a slag fire. I pay the hearth, not the order."
"Forty bars on one wagon. The Horde smells steel on a road, so ride hard."

manifest.name: Tidewrack Coast
manifest.description: A salt-bitten coast where the old Warden order is a harbour guard and the Horde's descendants sail as Reef Raiders. It inherits the Ashlands and re-skins them: the same battles, the same behaviour, new faces.

regions.name: The Tidewrack Coast
regions.description: A coast of lighthouses, wrecks and long grey beaches.

locations.name: Gull Harbour
locations.description: A crooked port town built from ship timber.

locations.name: Wreck Strand
locations.description: A beach strewn with hulls, ideal cover for raiders.

factions.name: Harbour Guard
factions.description: Lamp-keepers and pikes of the Tidewrack ports.

factions.name: Reef Raiders
factions.description: Goblin crews who strip wrecks and ports alike.

characters.name: Ilse Marrow
characters.title: Lampwarden of Gull Harbour
characters.background: A former ship's bosun who now keeps Gull Harbour's lamp lit and its raiders out. Mara Voss's counterpart in this world: she plays exactly like her.

characters.name: Pell Driftwood
characters.title: Beachcomber Scout
characters.background: Reads tides the way Tev reads smoke.

characters.name: Brannoch Saltfist
characters.title: Reef Brawler
characters.background: Hauls his catch with one hand and punches with the other.

characters.name: Captain Dredge
characters.title: Reef Raider Captain
characters.background: A berserker with a ship. Tougher than the Horde's Bolg on purpose: the Forge shows exactly how.

characters.name: Salt-Eyed Sniper
characters.title: Mast Archer
characters.background: Perches in rigging and shoots anyone who looks up.

characters.name: Tide-Whisper
characters.title: Reef Shaman
characters.background: Listens to the surf for omens.

characters.name: Gull-Hand
characters.title: Raider
characters.background: Quick, light and never where you aimed.

lore.name: The Lamp and the Tide
lore.text: Tidewrack's founders were Ashlands Wardens who followed the smoke to the sea. The order's creed, keep one fire lit, became the harbour lamp.

encounters.name: Clash at Wreck Strand
encounters.description: The Harbour Guard meet the raiders on the tide flats.
encounters.intro: The tide is going out and the raiders are coming in.

maps.name: Gorge: camp west, ruins east, two openings

quests.name: Reach and clear
quests.description: Go to a place, then win the fight there.

quests.name: Two-stop delivery
quests.description: Pick something up at one place and bring it to another.

quests.name: Signal and return
quests.description: Wait for a signal, then return to a place.
